evidence.title: Sphere 3D plans 50MW data center in Hopkinsville, Kentucky

summary: Sphere 3D, a high‑performance computing provider, will build a 50‑megawatt data center in Hopkinsville, Kentucky, aimed at expanding regional AI and cloud service capacity. The project is expected to create jobs and help meet the rising demand for AI‑intensive workloads.
title: Sphere 3D Announces Plans for 50MW Data Center in Hopkinsville, Kentucky
